chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"He who deceives a Muslim is not from us."

key_terms.لَيْسَ: is not; a phrase of negation and disavowal
key_terms.مُسْلِمًا: a Muslim; the one against whom deception is committed
key_terms.مِنَّا: from us; belonging to the moral way and community of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about deceiving a Muslim?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns deception against a Muslim and presents honesty as a defining mark of the community of faith. It emphasizes that fraud and betrayal are contrary to the moral path taught by the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, especially in social and commercial dealings.
